items.title: WorldOracle Tests Whether World Models Can Reliably Predict Real-World Executions
items.summary: Key Takeaways WorldOracle is a benchmark for action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) that scores each model's predicted rollout against the paired real-world execution, with both starting from the same initial observations and following the same action sequence. Seven representative models were evaluated; arm motion was predicted relatively well, but object positions and movements often deviated from reality, and performance dropped over complete operation sequences. The platform opened to developers on October 16 and accepts both open-weight and closed-source models. In one WorldOracle case, the robot's grasp missed, yet the world model predicted a successful pick.
